name: Lockstep
description: Binds every fund-moving call to the exact skill version the account owner approved.

account.description: Account holding the funds, delegated to LockstepGuard via EIP-7702.

rpcUrl.description: Monad RPC URL. Defaults to the public endpoint for the chain.

executorPrivateKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the executor key. The key itself is never stored in config. The executor pays gas and holds no funds; it must never be the account's key, and the chain adapter refuses to start if it is.

skillRoots.description: Skills roots a resolved skill must live under. Defaults to the workspace skills directory.
